notes.title: Patch notes - November 4th
notes.content:
Hey everyone, thanks for playing the game and giving us feedback, we are very exited for the result with one month for development.
Here is our first update for the game, there were some things that we wanted to add for the release but couldn't make it in time. So here's the list.

[list]
[*]We added the possibility to change text speed
[*]We did some changes in the UI
[*]We did some changes on the house
[*]We fixed some small bugs
[*]And the biggest change. We added achievements!!!
[/list]

There are still some updates planned for the future before the second episode's release.

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: 🎉 Tales of the Uncanny is Out Now! Dive into the Shadows! 🎉
notes.content:
Happy Halloween! We’re thrilled to announce that Tales of the Uncanny is now available on Steam. Get ready to explore a chilling anthology of stories where the line between reality and the uncanny blurs. Each chapter in Tales of the Uncanny reveals a unique narrative, some grounded in dark realism, others diving into the supernatural. As you journey through each unsettling tale, your choices will shape the experience and ultimately the outcome of each story.

🌑 Available Chapters:

Strange Lovebirds: Meet Nathan, an independent journalist whose first date takes a dark and twisted turn. Uncover the truth behind this nightmare-turned-romance in our opening chapter!
💀 What to Expect:

Atmospheric Horror: Each story offers an immersive experience with eerie environments, haunting sounds, and gripping narratives.
Choice-Driven Outcomes: Shape each chapter’s path with your decisions, unlocking different fates and endings.
Ongoing Stories: This is just the beginning! New standalone chapters will be released as DLCs, each adding a fresh tale to the anthology.
🕯️ Celebrate Halloween by diving into the world of Tales of the Uncanny! Don’t forget to leave your feedback, add the game to your wishlist, and share your experiences with us. We can’t wait to hear what you think about Tales of the Uncanny and stay tuned for more tales that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

Happy haunting, and see you in the uncanny!
